ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (dark) pixels to high-intensity (white/light) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally dominant low-intensity (black) field extending from the insertion point to the median notch. High-intensity (white) mottling and contiguous geometric patches are concentrated at the distal terminal tips of both lobes. Multiple discrete, high-contrast circular white focal spots are distributed across the mid-lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire span of the trailing edge, with increased amplitude and irregularity at the lateral lobe extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a slightly concave curve near the median notch, transitioning into a broad convex sweep towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular white pixel rings (rosettes) are visible on the distal tips and scattered in the dark interior regions of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions are detected on the upper distal quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and irregular pigment loss at both fluke tips, likely corresponding to past colonization or physical contact.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetry of white circular 'ring' marks appearing in the mid-lower quadrant of both lobes.
